title: The Work orders and Both filters list only customers on exactly that channel
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and tier A for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders and Default for Part Sales.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, on Default for work orders and tier A for Part Sales.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Open the channel filter.
  5. Pick Work orders.
  6. Open the channel filter.
  7. Pick Both.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The tab lists customers A, B and C.

Step 4:

  • The filter offers Work orders, Part Sales and Both.

Step 5:

  • Customer B (on tier A for work orders, Default for Part Sales) is listed.
  • Customers A and C are hidden: A is on tier A for both channels, C for Part Sales only.

Step 6:

  • The filter offers Work orders, Part Sales and Both.

Step 7:

  • Customer A (on tier A for work orders and Part Sales) is listed.
  • Customers B and C are hidden: each is on tier A for one channel only.
